legal.notice: RiskLex is informational and does not replace advice from a lawyer.

consent.title: Before analyzing
consent.what: To analyze it, RiskLex will send the text of the document you pasted to the RiskLex backend, which passes it to its artificial intelligence provider.
consent.retention: The artificial intelligence provider may keep the data temporarily: up to 30 days, or longer if some content is flagged for review. RiskLex does not store the document or the result.
consent.advice: Do not paste information you do not want to share, such as passwords or health data.
consent.session: We will ask you again the next time you open RiskLex.

input.label: Document text
input.hint: Paste the terms and conditions or the privacy policy here.
input.tooLong: The text is longer than the {{max}} character limit. Shorten the document and try again.

steps.waiting_for_analysis: Analyzing with artificial intelligence. It can take up to two minutes.
steps.verifying_quotes: Checking that every quote appears in your document
steps.retrying: Repeating the analysis to verify more quotes

analyze.title: What are you about to accept today?
analyze.lead: Paste the text of the terms or the privacy policy. We tell you, in plain words, what could happen if you accept.
analyze.emptyHint: Paste the document text to analyze it.

invalid_request.message: We could not read the text you sent.
invalid_request.next: Check that you pasted the whole document and try again.

document_too_large.message: The document is too long to analyze at once.
document_too_large.next: Shorten it below {{max}} characters and try again.

rate_limited.message: Too many analyses were made in a row.
rate_limited.next: Wait a minute and try again.

provider_error.message: The artificial intelligence service did not respond properly.
provider_error.next: Try again in a few minutes.

provider_refusal.message: The artificial intelligence service declined to analyze this text.
provider_refusal.next: Check that it is a terms or privacy document and try again.

output_truncated.message: The analysis was incomplete because the document is very long.
output_truncated.next: Try a shorter part of the document.

network_unavailable.message: We could not connect to RiskLex.
network_unavailable.next: Check your internet connection and try again.

timeout.next: Try again. If it happens again, try a shorter document.

cancelled.next: You can analyze the document again whenever you want.

invalid_response.message: We received a response we could not understand.
invalid_response.next: Try again in a few minutes.

low_reliability.message: We could not confirm any quote of the analysis in your document, so we are not showing it.
low_reliability.next: Check that the text is complete and try again.

configuration_missing.message: The RiskLex server address is not configured.
configuration_missing.next: If you develop the app, follow the README instructions and open RiskLex again.

analysis_in_progress.next: Wait for it to finish or cancel it before starting another one.

unexpected.next: Try again. If it happens again, close and reopen RiskLex.
